problem: The current N.E.K.O product pin predates native TTS HTTP pooling/preconnect and substantial realtime/ASR connection-generation hardening now present at d90. XiaoYu must determine whether those native capabilities can replace private lifecycle glue and improve first-audio/reconnect reliability without blindly upgrading across 46 upstream commits or breaking the 14 managed product patches.

prior_review_freshness.stale_observation: governance:voice-replacement-reconnect-soak-v1 previously recorded latest upstream as equivalent to c3; upstream has since advanced to d90, so that L2 observation is no longer valid for promotion decisions.
prior_review_freshness.rule: Do not edit historical evidence to pretend it knew about d90; this candidate is the fresh superseding upstream investigation.

direct NEKO_UPSTREAM.lock.json promotion before candidate acceptance closes

files.main_logic/tts_client/_http_pool.py: native pooled TTS clients with longer keepalive for stale-idle first-sentence failures
files.main_logic/tts_client/_preconnect.py: TTS_PRECONNECT_SENTINEL + SpareSocket ownership, bounded handshake/confirm/retired-close lifecycle
files.main_logic/tts_client/workers/qwen.py: bounded reconnect while retaining speech identity and staged text; tracked socket retirement

managed_patch_overlap.implication: File overlap is not proof of conflict, but it is a machine-relevant reason to require ordered git-apply compatibility plus focused native/XiaoYu tests before promotion.

selected_candidate_work.stage_1: Build a fixed-d90 candidate checkout and machine probe. Reuse git apply --check/apply in declared patch order; never mutate product pin.
selected_candidate_work.stage_2: Run d90 native preconnect/socket ownership tests on the clean candidate.
selected_candidate_work.stage_3: If and only if managed patch replay succeeds, run the existing XiaoYu patched Companion Voice ownership/Qwen bundle tests on the candidate product state.
selected_candidate_work.verdict: Emit a structured promotion-ready=false/true candidate verdict. A blocker is a successful probe result, not permission to bypass it.

acceptance: candidate is pinned to d90; no moving-main nonreproducibility
ordinary product N.E.K.O pin remains c3
candidate validates native TTS preconnect/socket ownership tests
candidate replays all managed patches in series order or records the exact first incompatible patch/file as a promotion blocker
when patch replay succeeds, existing XiaoYu Voice/Qwen ownership tests must pass on d90 before promotion_ready can become true
candidate never copies d90 HTTP pool/preconnect/transport implementation into XiaoYu overlay
promotion_ready must remain false on any patch conflict, native test failure, XiaoYu product test failure, missing candidate test, or license mismatch
retirement_condition: Retire this candidate probe after a specific newer N.E.K.O pin is promoted and all replaced XiaoYu patches are retired/rebased with equivalent product acceptance, or when upstream itself ships the remaining XiaoYu-specific Qwen bundle/policy behavior and the managed patches disappear.

run clean d90 native preconnect/Qwen reconnect tests
create a disposable d90 worktree and replay series.json in declared order with git apply --check/apply/reverse-check
